Demonstrate mastery through weekly, module, and final assessments.

weeks.title: Colonial America & Founding: Historical/geographic inquiry
weeks.instructor_overview: Introduce and develop historical/geographic inquiry within the context of Colonial America & Founding. Use explicit instruction, worked examples or models, guided practice, and independent application.

Analyze relationships among people, institutions, events, or places.
Support conclusions using relevant evidence and context.

Analyze relationships among people, institutions, events, or places.
Support conclusions using relevant evidence and context.
